cv.name: Alex Morgan
cv.subtitle: Data Engineering Lead | Azure Pipelines & Power BI Warehousing

summary.text: Data and software engineer with 9 years in retail security and operations, currently leading software and data for a 40-site security group.
Delivers Azure Data Factory and dbt pipelines and a SQL Server warehouse behind operational Power BI reporting.

bullets.text: Migrated 14 Power BI reports onto a central SQL Server data warehouse, which cut refresh time from 6 hours to 40 minutes.
Lead software and data in a 3-person IT team serving 1,200 staff across 40 sites.
Built an incident reporting portal in Python and React for 350 store users, which replaced spreadsheet recording.
Led Cyber Essentials certification with an external assessor, achieved in March 2024.
Improved data quality by 35% through automated validation checks.
Deliver Azure Data Factory and dbt pipelines for venture capital and legal-tech clients.
Engineered a document ingestion pipeline processing 20,000 legal PDFs per month.
Helped analyse incident and stock-loss data across 85 stores, which pinpointed hotspots for regional managers.
Automated weekly shrink reporting in SQL and Excel VBA, saving 10 hours per week.

statement.heading: Designing and maintaining data pipelines in Azure
statement.text: As a part-time data engineering consultant at Brightpath Analytics I deliver Azure Data Factory and dbt pipelines for venture capital and legal-tech clients. One of these is a document ingestion pipeline that processes 20,000 legal PDFs every month.

statement.heading: SQL, warehousing and Power BI reporting
statement.text: At Northgate Security Group I migrated 14 Power BI reports onto a central SQL Server data warehouse, which cut the refresh time from 6 hours to 40 minutes for operational teams.

paragraphs.text: I am applying for the Data Engineering Lead role (ref PHT-0458). For the past three years I have led software and data at Northgate Security Group, where I moved 14 Power BI reports onto a central SQL Server warehouse and cut refresh time from 6 hours to 40 minutes.
Your person specification asks for Azure pipelines, strong SQL and warehousing, and Power BI reporting for operational teams. Here is how my work maps to it:

You describe an Azure platform that supports 30,000 homes and a small team of analysts to lead. That combination of operational reporting and team development is the work I want to do next, in an organisation whose data serves tenants directly.

I work by putting reliable data in front of the people who make decisions, documenting it so others can maintain it, and training users so reports get used. I have not worked in housing; my volunteer work for a homelessness charity is the closest experience I bring to the sector.

bullets.text: Deliver Azure Data Factory and dbt pipelines for venture capital and legal-tech clients, including ingestion of 20,000 legal PDFs a month.
Led Cyber Essentials certification with an external assessor, achieved in March 2024.
Automated weekly shrink reporting in SQL and Excel VBA, saving 10 hours per week.

cover_letter.closing: I would welcome the chance to discuss how I could help develop your data platform.
